responsibility: This header provides ELF configuration shared by C6X ELF targets, especially driver and assembler-spec wiring plus section naming for the target’s far-data and small-data model. It defines the assembler option translation for endianness, DSBT, PIC, and PID modes and selects the .fardata, .const, .far, .neardata, and .bss section conventions that the backend’s section hooks and linker environment rely on.
